events.what_it_is: A two-day Sarti Spritz U.S.-launch activation during NYFW with DJ sets, photo moments, branded experiences and giveaways.
events.what_is_free: Admission is offered by RSVP, with custom giveaways advertised while supplies last. The event centers on Sarti Spritz cocktails; no specific giveaway is guaranteed to every attendee.
events.caveats: 21+ only with physical government-issued photo ID. The current event listing explicitly says confirmed RSVP does not guarantee entry, so this is a guest-list style admission path rather than guaranteed entry. Giveaways are while supplies last.
events.practical_notes: Current sources agree on September 12–13, 3–7 PM at 480 W 13th Street. Use Sarti's official booking page for the current RSVP path and arrive early because confirmation does not guarantee entry.
